title: Income Tax: Child Benefit overpayments and the High Income Child Benefit Charge
text:
In some instances, it is possible for the High Income Child Benefit Charge (HICBC) to have been charged and an overpayment of Child Benefit to be later identified.

 This measure will:

 • offset Child Benefit overpayments against any HICBC payments made in relation to that overpayment, to correct the tax position.

 • have retrospective effect from the introduction of the High Income Child Benefit Charge in January 2013
